newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr skids vs yen on rise in Japan market rates.
newsitem.headline: Dlr skids vs yen on rise in Japan market rates.

text.p: 0557 GMT *Dollar fell against yen in late afternoon trade, primarily due to rises in Japan's market interest rates and mark selling for yen by Japanese investors, dealers said.
*It fell below support of 116.50 yen, where solid investor buying orders had been anticipated, but dealers said sharp falls below 116 yen unlikely.

*Japanese yen bonds fell on S&P's announcement of poor rating assignments to medium-sized Japanese life insurers, which led to speculation of possible selling of JGBs by the life insurers and dampened sentiment.

*Dollar stuck below 117 yen in afternoon Tokyo and trapped in extremely tight band between solid bids at 116.30-50 yen and selling interest by Japanese exporters and trust banks above 117.00 yen, dealers said.
*Stop-loss sales orders seen at 116.20 yen but any sharp fall unlikely due to buying interest from variety of operators, said a dealer at a U.S. bank in Tokyo.
*"The fact that the dollar is heading higher within an expected 115-118 yen range made traders loath to buy dollars above 117.00 yen," he added.
